sources.name: Edison Research exit poll
sources.publishers: the National Election Pool: CNN, ABC News, CBS News and NBC News
sources.method: Interviews voters as they leave polling places on election day, with phone and online interviews of early and mail voters, weighted to the vote count as it comes in.

sources.name: AP VoteCast
sources.publishers: The Associated Press, conducted by NORC at the University of Chicago
sources.method: Surveys registered voters online and by phone over the last days of voting, from a probability sample of the voter file plus an opt-in panel, weighted to the vote count as it comes in.
